answer: Bind each identity to a unique storage shard: at epoch start the agent receives a 100 MB slice of epoch-seeded data no one else holds, and must answer five random spot-checks inside two seconds, proving it actually stores the shard. A lotus grows one root per plot, and so does an honest agent: one shard, one disk, once. A farm faking 1,000 identities must store 100 GB of distinct shards and answer 5,000 checks per epoch, while a terrace of honest agents each holds a single shard. Miss a check and a 50 POA bond is slashed; an orchard of real disks beats a field of empty claims.
